latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the ZFS administration skill.

- Provides detailed, best-practice guidance for ZFS pool creation, expansion, and management on Linux and macOS.
- Includes dataset configuration, snapshot management, encryption setup, and recommended defaults.
- Emphasizes never using file-backed pools in production; strong production/test safety warnings.
- Covers performance tuning (recordsize, compression, ARC, SLOG, L2ARC), advanced vdevs, and workload recommendations.
- Supplies health check procedures and references for troubleshooting, replication, and platform-specific considerations.
